name: Sweet Potato Black Bean Burrito

ingredients.name: canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Preheat oven to 220°C. Dice sweet potato into 2 cm cubes; toss with 20 ml oil, paprika and 2 g salt. Roast for 25 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned.
Rinse rice and bring to a boil with 280 ml water and 1 g salt. Cover, simmer for 12 minutes and rest off the heat for 10 minutes.
Warm beans with cumin, remaining 40 ml water and 1 g salt for 5 minutes, mashing a small portion until thick.
Finely chop tomato, onion and coriander. Mix with lime juice and remaining 2 g salt; drain any pooled liquid before filling.
Warm 4 large tortillas until pliable. Divide rice, beans, sweet potato and salsa among them, leaving the edges clear. Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Brush a pan with remaining 10 ml oil. Toast burritos seam-side down for 2 minutes, turn and toast for 2 minutes; cut across and serve.
tips: Keep beans thick and salsa drained so the wraps do not leak.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
